scripts.dev: npm run build -w @drive/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @drive/api" "npm run dev -w @drive/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @drive/shared && npm run build -w @drive/web && npm run build -w @drive/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @drive/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages docs scripts e2e .github *.json *.yml *.md *.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages docs scripts e2e .github *.json *.yml *.md *.ts
